name: tabulate
expr: T1 = tabulate(x1); T2 = tabulate(x2); T3 = tabulate(x3); T4 = tabulate(x4); s1 = sum(T1(:,3)); s2 = sum(T1(:,2));
comment: MATLAB tabulate: frequency table. Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on positive-int dense layout (with zeros for missing values), non-integer sparse layout, and NaN-excluded percentage. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship tabulate in core (statistics package only); reports N/A.
